description: Act XV of 1993 established 67 localities: 53 Malta and 14 Gozo. Creation statute is not the polling date of every first council.
EC identifies Act XXI of December 1999 as adding Mtarfa, the 68th locality. No predecessor/merger edge inferred.
Historical rows are attached to the same named legal council, not asserted to use identical polygons. A complete gazetted boundary-change audit remains open.
Current Act art.37A and Eleventh Schedule establish six regions. Earlier five-region subsidiary wording is not used to erase a current region. No guessed successor edges.
Former Gozo Civic Council and its president remain historical records; no identity equivalence with modern Gozo Region.
